status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet N2 (S2 native half)
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and Contents/App-Resources/Schema digests before the sitting; do not modify the bundle
Use copies of the case files from cases/ (cases.json gives SHA-256); open each with File > Open Live Set from a fresh launch with no unsaved set
Retain Log.txt, a screen capture of every dialog, and the bytes of every saved file; record whether the previously open set is still open after a failed load

probes.question: What exact bytes does 12.4.3 write when saving a new Live Set?
probes.existing_evidence: Writer 0x101485240: declaration constant 0x105b9b2b2, root 'Ableton', MajorVersion literal 5, MinorVersion '12.0' + '_' + newest translator (12402 from registry 0x10148ec98), SchemaChangeCount when > 0, Creator 'Ableton ' + 'Live 12.4.3', Revision e3d8be4d07c71dbd4de9e4183bf90652f680375b; gzip via deflateInit2_(level, 8, 31, 9, 0) in 0x1014338b0
probes.why_static_insufficient: The Live Set save reaches 0x101485c50 through a virtual call whose site and compression-level argument were not identified; SchemaChangeCount comes from a startup comparison with Schema/12.0_12402.txt; whitespace comes from writer virtual methods
probes.minimal_input: Fresh launch, File > New Live Set, File > Save Live Set As 'n2-probe-01.als'
probes.discriminating_observation: First 10 bytes (gzip or not; XFL 0/2/4; OS byte; MTIME; FLG), decompressed first two lines byte-for-byte, attribute order and values, line terminator and indentation of the third line
probes.stopping_condition: One saved file captured and hashed; stop

probes.question: Does File > Open accept an uncompressed .als, and does a later save keep it uncompressed?
probes.existing_evidence: Dispatchers 0x10148389c and 0x10146c258 route a stream starting with '<?' to the XML reader without an extension check
probes.why_static_insufficient: The open command's own checks before the dispatcher are not traced
probes.discriminating_observation: Set opens or not; saved file magic 1f 8b versus '<?'
probes.stopping_condition: One open and one save; stop

probes.question: What does the user see for each corrupt-document case, and does the previous set stay open?
probes.existing_evidence: Corrupt errors use localized key sErrorDocumentCorruptWhileReading (0x10148229c) with the document and a detail string formatted '{} (at line {}, column {})' (0x101247760); Languages.alp is opaque
probes.why_static_insufficient: Localized text, dialog layout and whether the detail is shown cannot be read statically
probes.discriminating_observation: Dialog text for each; Log.txt lines; whether a set remains open
probes.stopping_condition: Ten opens captured; stop at the first case that opens instead of failing and record it as a contradiction

probes.question: What newer-version message is shown, and is the version text taken from Creator?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x101528c84 chooses sErrorDocumentIsFromNewerVersion (empty Creator-derived version) or sErrorDocumentIsFromSpecificNewerVersion with the Creator remainder; 0x1015289c8 falls back to '<a>.<b>' from MinorVersion for a newer family
probes.why_static_insufficient: Localized texts are opaque; the general reader entry sets no expected Creator prefix, so the remainder may be the whole Creator
probes.minimal_input: cases N2-013 (MajorVersion 6), N2-019 (12.0_12403); then N2-019 with Creator removed
probes.discriminating_observation: Dialog text and whether it contains '12.4d1', 'Ableton Live 12.4d1' or no version

probes.question: Which reader entry does File > Open use, as shown by unknown MinorVersion families and gap translators?
probes.existing_evidence: With the Creator-aware entry 0x10146c0d4 the current version is (12, 4): 13.0_13000 is newer and 12.0_12050 is corrupt; the general entry 0x101484108 never sets those fields
probes.why_static_insufficient: Uninitialized comparison operands on the general path
probes.discriminating_observation: Corrupt versus newer-version dialog for each

probes.question: Do the statically accepted envelope variants open?
probes.existing_evidence: Version check 0x101529024 accepts MajorVersion 4 or 5 and any MinorVersion naming a Schema file; Revision is never read; Creator and SchemaChangeCount are optional; unknown root attributes are not examined
probes.why_static_insufficient: Whole-set loading after the envelope check was not traced
probes.discriminating_observation: Each opens without a dialog, or the dialog text

probes.question: What happens with a truncated gzip .als?
probes.existing_evidence: Gzip is reopened by file path through a gzip stream object (0x10146208c); its error handling was not traced
probes.why_static_insufficient: Gzip stream read errors were not traced
